purpose: Audit two fixed activity files before scoring any PPG detector. No glucose endpoint.
license: CC-BY-4.0 (original data; derivative record credits same source)
selection: sitting and walking fixed before analysis, all available subjects retained
reference_caveats: ECG R peaks provide cardiac beat reference, not expert-labelled PPG peaks.
Pulse transit delay and annotation indexing need explicit treatment before detector scoring.
Activity conversion retains first episode and lacks exact HR-window offset; do not use HR summaries as precise pulse labels.
Neither activities nor reference annotations provide hypoglycemia labels.
UCI and Zenodo describe CC BY 4.0; the older original university page states scientific non-commercial use. This project retains raw files locally and makes no commercial redistribution claim.
